title: Vast new fossil record challenges story of Earth’s ‘big five’ mass extinctions
title_zh: 庞大的新化石记录挑战地球‘大五’大灭绝的故事
abstract: An artificial-intelligence model trained on nearly four million fossils suggests that three of the extinction events might have happened more gradually than previously thought.
abstract_zh: 训练在近四百万化石上的AI模型表明，三个灭绝事件可能比以往认为的更缓慢地发生。
snippet: An artificial-intelligence model trained on nearly four million fossils suggests that three of the extinction events might have happened more gradually than previously thought.
